name: sports-banter
description: The room watches the game. Subscribes to `broadcast.message`, and when a sports line carries a `play` (a goal, a run, a home run, a double play, a fight, a man carried off, the final), sometimes has the NPCs in a room with the game on react: one of them to the room, or two fans on opposite sides in a short exchange, likeliest when their clubs are rivals. Each NPC backs a club per league (the same club gossip's favTeam names). Eligibility is npc-banter's own; shares `_ai.lastSay`. No verbs, no DB, no tick.
